group_name: Cherry St Doggie Ice Cream Social
canonical_name: Doggie Ice Cream Social Series (The Hop x Bone-A-Fide Pet Boutique)
summary: A monthly promotional pop-up co-hosted by two neighboring Cherry St businesses in downtown Black Mountain: The Hop Ice Cream Cafe and Bone-A-Fide Pet Boutique. Dogs get free 'Happy Tails' doggie ice cream with a $10+ purchase at The Hop, plus treats/activities from the pet boutique, held in the courtyard between the two shops. It reads as a recurring commercial promotion (like a drink/treat special) rather than a club with a defined membership; attendees are simply neighborhood dog owners dropping in, not a named, returning cohort.

evidence.note: Listings describe a casual drop-in hangout for 'neighborhood dogs' at a pet boutique, with no membership, sign-up, or club language, and no shared description text is even populated on most instances.

Search results (via exploreasheville, allevents.in, stayhappening, and the Black Mountain Swannanoa Chamber listing) describe the series as The Hop Ice Cream and Bone-A-Fide Pet Boutique teaming up: free doggie ice cream with a $10+ purchase from The Hop, dog treats/activities from Bone-A-Fide, monthly in the courtyard between the two Cherry St shops.

Bone-A-Fide Pet Boutique is a standard retail pet supply store (est. 2003, homemade treats) in downtown Black Mountain; no separate social-club page, roster, or membership structure exists for the ice cream social itself.

The recurring element is the two host businesses and their monthly promo cadence, not a persistent group of attendees who would recognize each other as members - closer to a recurring retail promotion than a club.
